gem_guidance.text: Although not the biggest upgrade, Carved Witch Doctor's Stick is one of the most exciting items we get this phase, as it enables more options and is easier to get than the previous best in slot. This is a great item to use towards getting your meta gem bonus using Glowing Shadowsong Amethyst . You can also equip the wand with Runed Crimson Spinel for raw damage. This wand replaces basically every past alternative, as you can swap the gem slot depending on what you need from it.

title: Burning Crusade Classic Frost Mage DPS Best in Slot (BiS) Phase 4 Guide - Wowhead
